title: Qt: Lua Debugger: Watch and Breakpoints controls in section headers
description:
CollapsibleSection gains setHeaderTrailingWidget() so the Lua debugger
can place a small control row next to the title and rule.

Watch: add, remove selected top-level watches, and remove all.
The Add Watch action is removed from the main debugger toolbar.

Breakpoints: activate-all / deactivate-all and remove all.

Shift+click on the editor gutter now toggles a breakpoint's active
state instead of removing it.

AI-Assisted: yes
